referenceNote: The supplied APK is version 1.5.3. The live official manual may describe a newer version. Capabilities are independently implemented and the inventory is not a binary-identical clone.

testCorrections.reason: Observed extra events are DisplayEngine.nudgeFocus DOWN/CANCEL at the same timestamp and the documented focus point, not the dismissing finger. Verify exact nudge pairs, zero UP/MOVE and unchanged click count; the next normal tap must still click.

UiAutomation includes NO_HIDE_DESCENDANTS nodes. Temporarily remove FLAG_INCLUDE_NOT_IMPORTANT_VIEWS to test the screen-reader tree, preserve both invisibility/clock-node assertions and restore flags in finally.
Wait for panes and connection to settle before asking by hand. A loading/error card intentionally refuses the clock; keep the original show assertion.
Real bug: clearing hidden Korean track text changes fallback font metrics and shifts the centred block. Retain the invisible line text while paused; keep the original exact height assertion.

Waiting for the UI between each half stretched the intended 20 ms gap beyond the 400 ms debounce. Dispatch a burst with original physical event timestamps; retain the assertions that the layout changes exactly once.
Real bug: injected text uses the same event timestamp for multiple DOWN/UP pairs. A matching release separates those presses; keep only counts and timestamps, never a typed key code or character.
Real bug: large-font music text measured 108 px in a 105 px box. Fit the own-item text to its actual space; retain measured-bounds assertions.
Real bug: a previous media-access hint remained after the playback state changed. Refresh the item hint with its state; retain the stale-hint assertion.

testCorrections.baseline: AB merged settings review; unpublished rc10 candidates A/B
testCorrections.reason: Review mistake corrected before publication: the persisted category ID controls is the General menu (DesignSettings.Page.GENERAL), not a separate Controls category. Restore that existing ID rather than the unrecognised general ID, which falls back to Screen. Retain the preference assertion and also assert the real General navigation item is selected.

The literal ETA fragment 2:32 also matched diagnostic timestamps 22:32:08 and 02:32:28. Match the ETA as a standalone time without adjacent digits or colon; retain all notification, address and distance privacy assertions.

The report delimiter starts with a newline. Both inline extraction and blockOf included that delimiter newline in the rendered block. Exclude it in both places; retain strict equality with the exact rendered bytes and all screen/report correspondence assertions.

Instrumentation.sendPointerSync targets the launcher UID and cannot tap PermissionController. The first failed answer also left orphan GrantPermissionsActivity instances: subsequent lookups saw only three invisible frame nodes, and before/timeout screenshots showed no dialog until teardown. Clear only the owned emulator PermissionController before this native case and in cleanup; use the real accessibility refusal button, reveal its short-screen position and refresh its nodes. Retain actual Android refusal, both ungranted permissions, zero receiver starts and subsequent launcher-touch assertions. Earlier failures and UI evidence are preserved.

Real bugs at system font scale 2.0: fixed-size step circles clipped their numbers, and the shared one-line panel title ellipsized the English setup title. Size circles from actual line height and allow panel titles to wrap; preserve the complete-text assertions in both languages.

Real bug: after re-showing a player blocked for 7 s, input still listed its old channel as ready while WindowManager reported mViewVisibility=0x8, mHasSurface=false and NO_SURFACE. Automatic focus keys then waited about 5 s. Check the exact focused ActivityRecord against a drawn display-0 WindowManager surface within the same bounded read; reject NO_WINDOW focus entries and unknown automatic-key targets. Retain all original refusal, zero waiting-key, ANR and recovery assertions. Add parser regressions from the saved records; diagnostic dumps exist only in owned-test evidence, never product logs/reports.

Real transition race: the input dump can still name the launcher as the focused application while the shown player has no surface. A drawn launcher window must not authorize a focus key for that player. Bind automatic player focus and Back readiness to its exact shown task ID as well as its drawn surface. The original 7 s stall, refusal and recovery assertions passed unchanged after this fix.

All 13 functional assertions passed, but the unchanged 6000 ms watchdog recorded a 6291 ms main-thread wait in BLASTBufferQueue.nativeCreate during a concurrent release build. Preserve the failed health result and stack. Repeat without concurrent build work; a successful recheck does not prove the root cause or establish that the Android rendering delay is fixed.

The immediate size read caught a transient system-bar inset frame after player focus (545 px instead of 660 px); IME was not shown. Await the same exact full-height car geometry for at most 5 s before the existing equality assertions. Retain all size, stored-share, divider and restoration assertions; failure remains if full height does not return.

testCorrections.source: LocalAdb.Session discovery lease before wireless restore
testCorrections.reason: Wireless debugging was switched on but replacement-port discovery returned zero on every retry. Keep a scoped NSD discovery lease alive before restoring wireless debugging and through the connection handoff; release it on success, failure or cancellation. The original real-Android automatic reconnection, setting-on, log and subsequent touch assertions passed unchanged. Pairing and reconnect are rechecked with authenticated TLS, never a substituted root bridge or invented port.

Two native setup attempts failed before pairing because the developer-settings row was absent and the setup activity remained in front. Context.startActivity after force-stopping Settings raced activity visibility/resumption. The owned UI driver now launches the actual Android developer page with am start -W --display 0 before finding its real pairing row. Retain genuine system-code pairing, wrong-code rejection, notification and successful TLS/bridge/touch assertions; no system dialog or connection is substituted.

runtimeVerification.scope: Latest evidence is selected per case and screen size. Older failed runs remain in history. Counts do not mean every case used the final binary. See parity JSON testCorrections for justified test-environment corrections.
